verdict.rationale: Working Copy has strong git primitives that could apply to automation files. Diffs and hunk staging support review, commit history and checkout of old versions support versioning, and Undo/Delete Commit support rollback. Automation itself runs through the Shortcuts app and repository scripts (JavaScript files inside repos), and the docs mention errors in repository scripts. However, nothing shows that Shortcuts automations themselves can be versioned or rolled back; that only works if the user keeps automation definitions as files in a repository. Missing for 10: first-class versioning/rollback of Shortcuts automations, documentation tying repository scripts to version history, independent or hands-on corroboration.
